description: Runtime transcript text normalisation. `server` is aiservice inference.normalize() today (Arabic yeh/kaf -> Persian, all whitespace collapsed to single spaces). `app_today` is jalase-negar normalizePersianAsrText() today; it is omitted where it equals `server`. Every entry where they differ is a divergence the parity contract must close.

cases.name: heh_with_yeh_above
cases.note: The app maps U+06C0 to U+0647 U+0654 and then strips U+0654 as a combining mark, so the effective result is a plain heh (latent app bug).
